descriptions.d24c_quake_handle_message_800d5b44: On id 64 call base 0x8015fb34 and on success call 0x800d5d44 and return 0, else return 0x80004005. On id 66 call 0x800d5f98 and forward to the base. Otherwise compare with four cached ids: first calls 0x800d6424 and returns 0; second calls 0x800d6788 and on non-zero sets +92 and returns 0; third calls 0x800d67d8 and returns 0; fourth calls 0x800d6904, sets +92 and returns 0. Otherwise forward to the base.
